messages:
Alex (Hiring Manager): FYI hiring closed for Senior Reliability Eng, start date Mon. Need a 1-page manager paste: first-5-day sprint + crisp 30/60/90 expectations I can drop in calendar and team intro. Any compact version?
Priya (People Ops): Yup. Here's a short manager-ready paste — keep it bite-sized so managers actually send it.
Priya (People Ops): "Manager paste: First-5-Day Sprint + 30/60/90
Preboard (before Day 1)
- Confirm device model, MDM enrollment, VPN/SSO, and office/badge logistics.
- Add to team Slack, GitHub teams, PagerDuty, and monitoring read groups. Assign buddy and book Day1 slots.
Day 1 (context + small wins)
- 9:00 AM (30m): Manager intro 1: role goals, top 3 priorities, communication norms.
- 10:00 AM (45m): Buddy tour (dev flow, dashboards, runbooks).
- 2:00 PM (30m): System overview with a senior engineer (high-level architecture).
- EOD (15m): Manager check-in: agree first-week micro-goal.
Days 2	61 (land & ship)
- Complete access checklist, run local dev, open trivial PR (docs/config).
- Shadow on-call, take notes, and update one runbook.
- Daily 1-hour pairing with domain SME.
Days 4	65 (deliver & show)
- Ship first small ticket and open PR.
- Present 10-min "what I shipped" in Friday sync.
- 30-min manager 1:1 to set the next 30-day focus.
30/60/90 manager outcomes (one-liners)
- 30d: Contributed & merged 2-3 small PRs; owns local dev flow; updated key runbook.
- 60d: Led a rollout or incident remediation end-to-end; proposed at least one measurable optimization.
- 90d: Independent ownership of a service/infra surface with SLIs and a short improvement plan.
Manager 1:1 cadence (suggested)
- Week1: daily 15m quick syncs.
- Weeks2-4: 2x/week 30m.
- After 30d: weekly 30-60m.
Sample line to post in team channel:
"Please welcome @newhire to Reliability! Buddy: @Ben. First-week micro-goal: ship a small infra config PR and update a runbook."
"
Marisol (IT): @Alex send me the job code + office location and Ill pre-stage the laptop/dock Friday.
Ben (Buddy): I'll schedule a tour + two pair slots Tue/Thu. I'll also draft the tiny first-ticket idea (config lint or doc fix).
Ravi (Oncall Lead): Recommend adding a 3-bullet on-call shadow checklist for day2: what pages look like, how to ack & escalate, and where to find postmortems.
Priya (People Ops): Good call 1 added a short on-call checklist into the manager paste (handbook PR incoming).
onboard-bot: welcome packet & manager calendar template applied to Alex's new hire (automated).
Alex (Hiring Manager): Thank you all 1 I'll paste this into the offer-acceptance thread and the Day1 channel intro.
